title: Real Estate Data Manager (List Management & Duplicate Prevention Systems)
description:
We are a land investing company looking for an experienced Data Manager to build a clean, organized system for managing our property data.



This is not a basic data entry role.



We pull property records, skip trace them, and market directly to sellers. Our biggest bottleneck right now is data management. We need a system that ensures we are not pulling or paying for the same data more than once.



Our goal is to eliminate wasted spend from duplicate and repeated data pulls.



We currently pull property data using Land Portal, Land Insights, and Land Vision software, so experience working with exported property or parcel datasets (CSV/Excel) is important.



We are looking for someone who can build a simple, effective system to manage and prevent duplicate property data at scale.



Responsibilities:

Review and organize our existing Google Sheets data

Build a master database of all property records we’ve pulled

Create a system to remove duplicate records and prevent us from repulling the same properties in the future

Set up a process to compare new lists against existing data before skip tracing

Structure and tag data (date pulled, skip traced, follow-up timelines, etc.)

Create a clear, repeatable workflow (SOP) for pulling, cleaning, and preparing data

Recommend improvements to make the system more efficient and cost-effective

Requirements:

Advanced experience with Google Sheets or Excel

Experience working with real estate or property data (land is a strong plus)

Strong understanding of removing duplicate records and preventing repeated data pulls over time

Familiarity with parcel-level data (APN, owner records, etc.)

Ability to build simple, scalable systems

Clear communication and ability to explain your process step-by-step

Build and implement a process within our data software (Land Portal) to prevent exporting duplicate property records, including creating and maintaining suppression lists to filter out previously pulled data

Project Scope:



Important:



This role is focused on building a system that prevents duplicate data from ever being used.



This includes:



Preventing repurchasing the same property records more than once

Preventing duplicate skip tracing on records already processed

Structuring data so new lists are checked against existing records BEFORE any skip tracing or processing happens

We  want to implement a system that prevents pulling duplicate records directly within our data software (Land Portal) before export, using suppression lists or similar tools. The goal is to eliminate duplicates at the source and create a simple, repeatable process that can be followed every time new data is pulled.





This is not just about cleaning data — it’s about building a system that eliminates unnecessary spend and ensures we only work with new, unused records.



This is a project-based role to build out our data system using our current datasets.



If the system works well, there will be ongoing work to manage and maintain it.



How to Apply:



Please answer the questions below in detail:



1. Walk me through a system you’ve built to manage large datasets. How was it structured and how was it used day-to-day?

2. Explain how you would make sure we never pull or skip trace the same property twice, even months later. What fields or identifiers would you use?

3. If you were given multiple property lists pulled at different times, how would you combine them into one clean master database?

4. How would you track when data should be reused or repulled (ex: 3 months, 6 months, 12 months)?

5. What tools, formulas, or methods do you use in Google Sheets or Excel to clean and organize data efficiently?



Compensation:

Please include your fixed price for completing this project and briefly outline what deliverables you would provide (for example: master sheet, duplicate filtering system, SOP/process, etc.).

title: HubSpot Solutions Architect
description:
HubSpot Solutions Architect (Senior, Client-Facing)



Department: CRM Architecture

Employment Type: Full-Time

Location: Remote



About the Role

We are seeking an experienced Senior HubSpot Solutions Architect to lead the technical and strategic design of complex HubSpot engagements. This client-facing role is responsible for translating business requirements into scalable HubSpot solutions, guiding clients through discovery, solution architecture, implementation planning, and delivery oversight.



The ideal candidate combines deep HubSpot expertise with strong consulting, solution design, and stakeholder management skills. You will collaborate with consultants, implementation specialists, developers, RevOps professionals, and client executives to ensure every solution aligns with business objectives while following HubSpot best practices.



Key Responsibilities

~ Lead discovery workshops to understand client business processes, goals, technical requirements, and growth strategy.

~ Design scalable HubSpot architectures across Marketing Hub, Sales Hub, Service Hub, Operations Hub, Commerce Hub, and Content Hub.

~ Develop solution blueprints covering CRM structure, automation, integrations, custom objects, reporting, governance, and data strategy.

~ Serve as the primary technical advisor throughout client engagements, translating business requirements into practical HubSpot solutions.

~ Define implementation roadmaps, project phases, priorities, and technical dependencies.

~ Review proposed solutions to ensure scalability, maintainability, security, and alignment with HubSpot best practices.

~ Provide architectural oversight during implementations, migrations, and platform optimization projects.

~ Collaborate with developers and integration specialists on API integrations, middleware solutions, and custom HubSpot extensions.

~ Advise clients on CRM strategy, lifecycle management, automation, reporting frameworks, and RevOps best practices.

~ Identify risks, technical limitations, and alternative approaches before implementation begins.

~ Conduct architecture reviews, solution validation, and quality assurance throughout project delivery.

~ Mentor consultants and implementation teams on solution design standards and architectural best practices.

~ Stay current with new HubSpot capabilities, platform updates, and emerging CRM technologies.



Required Qualifications

~ 5+ years of experience designing and delivering complex HubSpot solutions in client-facing consulting environments.

~ Extensive experience across multiple HubSpot Hubs and enterprise CRM architecture.

~ Strong understanding of CRM design, data modeling, lifecycle management, automation, and customer journey architecture.

~ Experience leading technical discovery sessions and translating business requirements into scalable platform designs.

~ Deep knowledge of HubSpot custom objects, workflows, permissions, reporting, and enterprise governance.

~ Experience architecting integrations with ERP, CRM, marketing automation, customer support, and third-party platforms.

~ Familiarity with HubSpot APIs, middleware platforms, and integration architecture principles.

~ Strong understanding of RevOps, sales processes, marketing operations, and customer success workflows.

~ Excellent client communication, presentation, and executive stakeholder management skills.

~ Experience leading cross-functional project teams across consulting, implementation, and development.

~ Strong analytical, documentation, and solution design capabilities.

~ Ability to manage multiple enterprise engagements simultaneously.



Preferred Qualifications

~ Multiple HubSpot Certifications.

~ Experience with Salesforce, Microsoft Dynamics, NetSuite, SAP, or other enterprise CRM/ERP platforms.

~ Knowledge of iPaaS platforms such as Make, Zapier, Workato, or MuleSoft.

~ Experience designing enterprise reporting and business intelligence solutions.

~ Familiarity with Agile delivery methodologies and solution governance frameworks.

~ Experience supporting global or multi-business-unit HubSpot implementations.

connect with our audience in exciting ways. If you're passionate about jewelry, social media, and content creation, 

this role is perfect for you! 



POSITION SUMMARY: 

The Jewelry Buyer & Production Coordinator will handle both the sourcing and production aspects of jewelry, 

including purchasing inventory, managing production processes, and ensuring quality control. They would also 

need to maintain strong relationships with suppliers and manufacturers.

  

DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES (include but not limited to the following): 

Sourcing and Purchasing: 

• Research and identify new vendors and suppliers.  

• Negotiate prices, quantities, and delivery schedules with suppliers.  

• Place and manage purchase orders for jewelry.  

• Oversee the entire buying process, from vendor pack preparation to order placement.  

• Analyze sales performance and suggest new brands or products.  

• Stay informed about jewelry trends and market demands.  



Production Coordination: 

• Monitor production schedules and ensure timely delivery of products.  

• Coordinate with manufacturing partners to ensure quality standards and ethical practices are met.  

• Resolve production challenges and ensure efficient workflow.  

• Manage inventory levels and track stock.  

• Provide guidance on resolving production or supply chain issues.  



Other Responsibilities: 

• Maintain strong relationships with suppliers and manufacturers.  

• Ensure all products meet quality standards and ethical guidelines.  

• May be involved in price analysis and setting retail prices.  

• May assist with inventory management and sales forecasting.

• High speed internet connection – PLDT Fiber Plan 1299, 100 mbs boosted speed or the exact same

• Must have their own high quality noise cancelling headset 

• 5-6 years previous experience working with a company in the United States 

• Exceptional English-speaking communication skills, both verbal and written 

• Must work NYC business hours 9:00 – 5:00 Monday through Friday 

• Bachelor’s degree in Business 

Abilities/Skills: 

• Knowledge of Jewelry: Understanding of jewelry materials, styles, and manufacturing processes.  

• Analytical and Math Skills: Analytical mindset with experience in data-driven decision-making.  Proficiency 

in Excel in order to analyze sales data, track inventory, and manage budgets 

• Negotiation and Communication Skills: Strong interpersonal and communication skills to interact with 

vendors and suppliers. Proactive mindset with a focus on improving user experience and sales performance.

highly desirable.  

• Ability to work in a Team: Positive attitude and demeanor that can work cross-functionally with marketing,

Preferred: 

• Reliable and regular attendance

title: Jewelry Dropship Manager
description:
POSITION SUMMARY: 

The Jewelry Dropship Manager will oversee the profitability, setup, and maintenance of jewelry drop ship 

styles. They facilitate communication between vendors and the buying team and manage relationships with 

suppliers. Key responsibilities include order fulfillment, quality control, and resolving issues related to shipping and 

product issues.

• Profitability Management:  Analyze profitability of drop ship styles, identify areas for improvement, and 

implement strategies to increase profitability and listing optimization. 

• Vendor Relationship Management:  Build and maintain strong relationships with jewelry suppliers, 

ensuring reliable supply, assortments, and competitive pricing.  

• Order Fulfillment:  Coordinate with suppliers to ensure timely and accurate fulfillment of customer orders.  

• Quality Control:  Inspect products and samples to ensure quality standards are met, and communicate with 

suppliers regarding defective products.  

• Shipping Coordination:  Manage shipping logistics, including packing and shipping orders, and resolving 

shipping-related issues.

relevant departments to facilitate seamless operations.

Address and resolve issues related to orders, billing, and product quality in a timely and efficient manner.  

• Product Management: 

Coordinate with suppliers on new product launches, seasonal items, and product promotions. Familiarity 

with listing platforms:  DSCO, Radial, Mirakl, Shopify 

• Forecasting and Planning: 

Assist in forecasting demand and managing inventory levels to ensure adequate supply.

integrations or updates.

title: Seller Cloud Ecommerce Technical Support

The SellerCloud Ecommerce Technical Support is responsible for providing technical assistance to jewelry 

sellers using the SellerCloud platform, troubleshooting issues, and ensuring smooth operations for their online 

sales. This role requires strong technical skills, problem-solving abilities, and a good understanding of e-commerce 

best practices, particularly within the jewelry industry.  



DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES (include but not limited to the following): 

• Technical Support: Address technical issues related to SellerCloud's features, integrations, and marketplace 

listings, specifically in the context of jewelry products. 

• Troubleshooting:  Diagnose and resolve problems related to inventory management, pricing, order 

fulfillment, and other e-commerce processes. 

• Issue Escalation:  Identify and escalate critical issues to the appropriate internal teams for resolution. 

• Knowledge Base:  Contribute to the documentation and maintenance of the SellerCloud knowledge base, 

ensuring accurate and up-to-date information. 

• Communication:  Effectively communicate with sellers, providing clear and concise technical assistance and 

updates. 

• Product Expertise:  Stay informed about the specific requirements of jewelry products on various e

commerce platforms and SellerCloud's features related to jewelry. 

• Problem-Solving:  Develop and implement solutions to address common technical issues faced by jewelry 

sellers. 

• Training:  Provide training or support to new sellers on using SellerCloud's features and functionalities. 

• Feedback:  Gather feedback from users on their experience with SellerCloud and identify areas for 

improvement.



QUALIFICATION REQUIREMENTS: 



Required: 

• High speed internet connection – PLDT Fiber Plan 1299, 100 mbs boosted speed or the exact same 

speed/product offered by competitor.  Lower speeds will not be accepted.  Bill needs to be provided, which 

includes name and a speed test (see below).   

• Must have their own high quality noise cancelling headset 

• 5-6 years previous experience working with a company in the United States 

• 1 year experience with Omni channel listings and DSCO experience 

• Exceptional English-speaking communication skills, both verbal and written 

• Must work NYC business hours 9:00 – 5:00 Monday through Friday 

• Bachelor’s degree in Business or IT 



Abilities/Skills: 

• Knowledge of Jewelry: Understanding of jewelry materials, styles, and manufacturing processes.  

• Technical Proficiency: Strong understanding of computer hardware, software, and networking concepts. 

• Troubleshooting Skills: Ability to diagnose and resolve technical issues efficiently and effectively. 

• E-commerce Knowledge: Familiarity with e-commerce platforms, marketplaces and sales processes. Specific 

experience in SellerCloud with Omni channel listings:  DSCO, Radial, Mirakl, Shopify, Wholesale and DTC 

Business model 

• Problem-Solving Skills: Ability to analyze problems, identify root causes, and develop solutions. 

• Software Proficiency: Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, Outlook) and other relevant 

software. 

• Analytical Skills: Ability to analyze data and identify trends related to technical issues. 

• Project Management:  Strong organizational skills and ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously.  

• Communication and Customer Service Skills: Ability to communicate technical information clearly and 

concisely, both verbally and in writing. Ability to communicate clearly and ask the right questions.  

• Organizational and Time Management Skills: Ability to manage multiple tasks and meet tight deadlines

title: Senior Bookkeeper (Remote | Philippines)
description:
We’re looking for an experienced Senior Bookkeeper based in the Philippines to support a growing U.S.-based company in the construction and building services industry.



This is a high-ownership role reporting directly to the CEO, ideal for someone who can confidently manage full-cycle bookkeeping, support leadership with accurate financial reporting, and help strengthen financial operations in a fast-paced remote environment.



This is more than a traditional bookkeeping role—it’s a strong opportunity for someone who wants long-term growth and the chance to take on broader finance responsibilities over time.



Key Responsibilities

Manage full-cycle bookkeeping and day-to-day accounting operations

Maintain reconciliations, journal entries, general ledger, and month-end close

Handle accounts payable and accounts receivable, including invoicing, collections, and vendor payments

Prepare accurate monthly, quarterly, and year-end financial reports

Support cash flow tracking, expense management, and financial reporting for leadership

Improve accounting workflows, reporting processes, and internal controls as the business scales

Coordinate with external U.S.-based CPAs, payroll providers, and accounting partners

Provide timely financial support and reporting directly to the COO



Qualifications

5+ years of bookkeeping or accounting experience, ideally in a senior-level role

Required: Experience working remotely with U.S.-based companies or leadership teams

Strong understanding of U.S. bookkeeping practices, including reconciliations, month-end close, accruals, and financial reporting

Proven ability to manage full-cycle bookkeeping independently

Strong proficiency in QuickBooks Online

Advanced proficiency in Excel and/or Google Sheets

Excellent written and verbal English communication skills

Highly organized, detail-oriented, and dependable

Able to work independently, stay responsive, and manage priorities in a remote environment

High level of integrity and discretion when handling sensitive financial information



Preferred Qualifications

Experience in construction, subcontracting, field services, or project-based businesses

Familiarity with job costing or construction bookkeeping

Experience working with U.S.-based CPAs, payroll providers, and tax/accounting partners

Experience in a growing or founder-led business

Interest in growing into a broader finance leadership role over time

title: # Breathwork, Meditation & Holistic Wellness Coach
description:
**Remote | Gig Project | Starting at $5/hr (Depending on Experience)**



I am looking for someone who is passionate about healing, personal growth, and holistic wellness to help guide me through different practices and teach me along the way.



This is a gig position that may continue on an ongoing basis if we are a good fit.



I am always interested in learning new healing modalities, improving my physical and mental well-being, and expanding my understanding of holistic health.



I am especially interested in working with someone who enjoys teaching and can explain concepts clearly while guiding me through practical exercises.



## Areas of Interest



I am particularly interested in learning about:



* Breathwork (high priority)

* Meditation

* Yoga

* Nervous system regulation

* Somatic practices

* Internal Family Systems (IFS)

* Energy healing

* Emotional regulation

* Mind-body connection

* Trauma-informed healing approaches

* Mindfulness

* Relaxation techniques

* Visualization practices

* Stress reduction

* Other holistic healing modalities



If you have experience in additional healing methods, I would love to hear about them as well.



## What You'll Be Doing



* Teaching and guiding me through sessions over Zoom or Google Meet

* Explaining the purpose behind different techniques and practices

* Helping me build healthy daily routines

* Answering questions and recommending resources

* Sharing your knowledge and experience

* Suggesting exercises that I can practice between sessions



This role is primarily educational and coaching-based. I am looking for someone who genuinely enjoys teaching others and helping them grow.



## Qualifications



Experience in one or more of the following is preferred:



* Breathwork facilitation

* Yoga instruction

* Meditation coaching

* Somatic practices

* Internal Family Systems (IFS)

* Nervous system regulation

* Energy healing

* Mindfulness coaching

* Trauma-informed coaching

* Holistic wellness

* Life coaching

* Psychology or related healing modalities



Formal certifications are appreciated but not required. Experience, knowledge, and the ability to teach clearly are most important.



## Who I'm Looking For



* Patient and supportive

* Excellent communicator

* Passionate about helping others

* Open-minded and compassionate

* Knowledgeable in one or more holistic healing practices

* Comfortable teaching over video calls

* Lifelong learner who enjoys sharing knowledge



## Compensation



Starting at **$5 per hour**, depending on experience and qualifications.



This is a gig position, with the possibility of ongoing sessions if we work well together.



## How to Apply



Please send either an
 or WhatsApp message including:



* Your name

* A short introduction

* Which healing modalities you specialize in

* Any certifications or relevant experience

* A short video (preferred) introducing yourself and explaining how you typically work with clients or students

* Any website, social media, YouTube channel, or testimonials you would like to share



I am always interested in learning, healing, and discovering new approaches to personal growth. If you believe you have something valuable to teach, I would love to hear from you.



Due to the number of applications, I may not be able to respond to everyone. I will contact the candidates whose background and experience best align with what I am looking for.

title: Accountant in Canada
description:
Remote File Preparer – Canadian CPA Firm (Full-Time, Work From Home)

Company: Chartered Professional Accountants – Calgary, Alberta, Canada 

Position: Accountant / File Preparer (Compilation Engagements & Tax) 

Location: Remote – Philippines 

Schedule: Full-time, 40 hours/week (some overlap with Mountain Time preferred) 

Salary: [PHP/CAD range] per month, paid via Wise/Payoneer



About Us

We are a small, established CPA firm in Calgary, Canada serving owner-managed businesses. We're growing and looking for a skilled accountant in the Philippines to join our team long-term.

The Role

You will prepare year-end compilation engagement files (Notice to Reader) and assist with Canadian corporate and personal tax returns. You'll work directly with our team and have real responsibility for client files from start to finish.

Responsibilities:

• Prepare compilation engagement (NTR) working paper files in Caseware, including adjusting journal entries, lead sheets, and financial statements

• Prepare Canadian corporate tax returns (T2) and personal tax returns (T1) in TaxCycle

• Perform bookkeeping and year-end cleanup in QuickBooks Online and Xero

• Process and code documents through Dext

• Reconcile bank, credit card, GST, and payroll accounts

• Prepare supporting schedules and correspondence in Excel and Word

• Communicate clearly with our Calgary team on file status and open items

Requirements

• Minimum 1 year of experience preparing compilation/NTR engagements at a Canadian accounting firm (or serving Canadian clients)

• Experience preparing Canadian T2 corporate and T1 personal tax returns

• Proficiency with Caseware and TaxCycle (or similar Canadian tax software such as Profile or CanTax)

• Working knowledge of QuickBooks Online, Xero, and Dext

• Strong Excel and Word skills

• BS Accountancy degree (CPA Philippines an asset)

• Excellent written and spoken English

• Reliable high-speed internet, own computer, and quiet home workspace

• Strong attention to detail and ability to manage multiple files and deadlines

Nice to Have

• Experience with GST returns, T4/T5 slip preparation

• Familiarity with Alberta/Canadian payroll

• Experience working night shift or partial overlap with North American hours

What We Offer

• Stable, long-term full-time position with a growing firm

• Direct mentorship from Canadian CPAs

• 13th month pay

• Paid Canadian statutory holidays [or Philippine holidays – your choice]

• Annual performance-based raises

• Opportunity to grow into a senior file preparer role

How to Apply

Send the following to 

1. Your updated resume

2. A short cover letter describing your Canadian firm experience — which software you used and what types of files you prepared

3. Your expected monthly salary and earliest start date

4. Put "NTR File Preparer – [Your Name]" in the subject line (applications without this subject line will not be reviewed)

Shortlisted candidates will complete a short paid test assignment followed by a video interview.

Ensure the acquisitions team always has enough qualified properties to price

Smarter Contact

Launch Control

Batch Leads

Land investing

Real estate acquisitions

High-volume SMS marketing





This Position Is NOT For You If

You wait to be told what to do.

You miss small details.

You respond slowly.

You dislike repetitive work.

You make excuses instead of solving problems.

You cannot handle a fast-paced environment.



What Success Looks Like

Successful tea
mbers:

Reply to sellers in under 5 minutes

Pay close attention to detail and rarely make mistakes

Keep campaigns organized and running efficiently

Never let follow-ups fall behind

Identify problems before they become issues

Find ways to improve our systems and processes

Think like an owner, not just an employee

Help the acquisitions team close more deals





APPLICATION INSTRUCTIONS

Read Carefully.

Applicants who fail to follow these instructions will automatically be rejected.

Your resume.

 Tell us about one process you improved at a previous job and how it made the business better.

Ping

title: IP, Copyright, Trademark & Public Domain Research Specialist
description:
We are an asset-light IP holding and brand licensing platform modeled on enterprise brand managers like Authentic Brands Group and Disney. We acquire, transform, and protect high-equity trademarks and public domain assets, licensing them out to best-in-class operators while retaining 100% ownership of the core IP. We operate entirely in text, code, and legal frameworks—we own the asset, the licensee owns the overhead.



The Role

We are seeking a brilliant, highly meticulous IP, Copyright & Public Domain Research Specialist to act as the internal human layer for our forensic asset research. In this role, you will be 100% focused on legal data, clearance, and asset tracking. You will utilize Google Gemini alongside official databases to clear trademarks, register copyrights, map out the entry of legacy works into the public domain, and build institutional background dossiers on distressed brands targeted for acquisition.



Daily Responsibilities

US Copyright Execution: Prepare and systematically file official US copyright applications for all original Ventured materials, layout structures, and transformed derivative works.



USPTO Forensic Research: Actively monitor the USPTO database to isolate dead, cancelled, or lapsed zombie brands (specifically tracking Section 8/9 renewal failures) matching our target lifestyle and consumer criteria.



Acquisition Fact-Checking & Dossier Building: Conduct exhaustive background research on potential brand acquisitions, compiling comprehensive dossiers for executive review that break down financial health, past operational scale, corporate history, and brand narratives.



Public Domain Timeline Mapping: Audit and project the exact years legacy creative works, literature, characters, and assets will enter the public domain under US law, flagging high-commercial-value opportunities for our revival pipeline.

Data & Vault Organization: Maintain pristine, hyper-organized tracking systems within Google Docs and Google Sheets, documenting all active filings, renewal timelines, and pre-vetted brand data.

title: Google Local Service Ads QA/QC Representative
description:
Google Local Service Ads QA/QC Representative



We are a group of fast-growing, U.S.-based marketing agencies helping honest, hardworking local service businesses grow through effective digital marketing. Our brands include Honest Mechanic Marketing, Honest Roofer Marketing, and DTL Consultants.



We work primarily with automotive repair shops (70%), roofing companies, and other local service businesses. Our mission is simple: help good businesses get better leads, better tracking, and better results without fluff or false promises.



We are looking for a detail-oriented Google Local Service Ads QA/QC Representative to join our remote team. This role is focused on reviewing phone calls generated from Google Local Service Ads, documenting lead quality, adding notes inside Google, and preparing clear reports for our Client Services team.



This is a great role for someone who is organized, consistent, comfortable listening to U.S.-based phone calls, and able to identify whether a call was a good lead, bad lead, missed opportunity, spam, wrong service, or other issue.



Role Overview:

The Google LSA QA/QC Representative will be responsible for reviewing call recordings from Google Local Service Ads accounts across multiple clients. You will listen to calls, evaluate the quality of each lead, add accurate notes into the Google LSA platform, and update internal reports so our Client Services team can communicate clearly with clients.



This role requires strong English comprehension, excellent attention to detail, and the ability to follow a consistent review process.



Key Responsibilities:



Review Google Local Service Ads call recordings for multiple clients.

Listen carefully to U.S.-based phone calls and determine the quality of each lead.

Identify whether each call was a valid lead, poor-quality lead, spam call, wrong number, wrong service, missed call, booking opportunity, or other category.

Add clear, accurate notes inside the Google Local Service Ads dashboard.

Update internal spreadsheets or reports with call details, lead quality, and important observations.

Flag calls that may need follow-up from the Client Services team.

Identify trends such as repeated bad leads, missed calls, unanswered calls, wrong service requests, or customer service issues.

Help the team understand what types of calls clients are receiving from LSAs.

Provide weekly call review summaries for the Client Services team.

Follow internal QA/QC standards to ensure calls are reviewed consistently and accurately.



What You Will Be Reviewing:



Examples of what you may need to identify:

Was this a real customer looking for service?

Did the caller ask for a service the client provides?

Was the call answered professionally?

Did the client miss the call?

Was the caller trying to book an appointment?

Was the call spam, sales-related, or irrelevant?

Was the lead worth disputing or marking as poor quality?

Are there patterns the client needs to know about?



Requirements:



Excellent English listening comprehension, especially with U.S.-based callers.

Strong written English for clear notes and reporting.

High attention to detail.

Ability to follow a process consistently.

Comfortable using Google platforms, spreadsheets, and online reporting tools.

Reliable internet connection and computer setup.

Ability to work independently and complete assigned call reviews on time.

Strong organization skills.

Comfortable with repetitive review work while maintaining accuracy.

Experience with Google Local Service Ads is a plus, but not required. Training will be provided.

Experience in call review, quality assurance, customer service, virtual assistant work, lead tracking, or digital marketing is helpful.



Preferred Qualifications:



Previous experience reviewing sales calls, customer service calls, or lead quality.

Familiarity with Google Local Service Ads, Google Ads, Google Business Profile, or digital marketing.

Experience working with U.S.-based businesses or agencies.

Experience with automotive repair, roofing, home services, or local service businesses.

Comfortable creating simple weekly summaries and reports.



Working Hours:



This is a remote position.

Flexible hours are available, but some availability during U.S. business hours is preferred.

Full-time candidates may be considered.



Why Join Us?



Work remotely with a growing U.S.-based marketing team.

Stable and consistent workload for the right person.

Long-term growth potential.

Training provided.

Supportive team environment.



Opportunity to grow in digital marketing, call tracking, lead quality, and Google Local Service Ads.

Mission-driven company that values honesty, transparency, client results, and clear communication.

Ideal Candidate



The ideal candidate is someone who is careful, consistent, and responsible. You do not need to be a Google Ads expert, but you do need to be able to listen closely, understand what happened on a call, document it clearly, and help our team protect lead quality for our clients.

? Coordinate estimators, subcontractors, and suppliers so information arrives on time.

? Run quality assurance so no proposal leaves the building with an error.

? Submit flawlessly, capture confirmations, and archive everything.

? Manage post-award compliance setup so we start projects clean.

? Maintain the document library, databases, and compliance calendar as living systems.



Daily, Weekly, Monthly & Annual Responsibilities



The role runs on rhythm. These checklists convert the mission into repeatable habits.



2.1 Morning Checklist (first 90 minutes)

?  Review the Deadline Tracker; confirm every open bid's due date, time, and time zone.

?  Check all portal notifications (
, NJSTART, BidNet Direct, PennBid, county/municipal, school, housing authority) for new opportunities and, critically, new addenda/amendments.

?  Log any new addenda in the Addenda Log for every active pursuit and flag scope/price impacts to the estimator.

?  Scan
 for subcontractor/supplier quotes, RFI responses, and agency communications; file and log each.

?  Update the Opportunity Tracker status for anything that changed overnight.

?  Identify today's single most important deadline and block time to protect it.

?  Raise any red flags (missing bond, expiring insurance, unclear spec) to your manager before 10:00 a.m.



2.2 Afternoon Checklist



?  Advance the top-priority bid package: assemble documents, request missing items, update the checklist.

?  Follow up on outstanding subcontractor/supplier quotes and RFIs with a written, logged request.

?  Verify that any addenda received today are incorporated into the estimate and the package.

?  Confirm bonding and insurance are in motion for bids due within 7 days.

?  Update the Question Log; submit any pre-bid questions well before the solicitation's question deadline.

?  Perform a mid-stage QA pass on any package reaching 75% completion.



2.3 End-of-Day Checklist



?  Reconcile the Deadline Tracker: every active bid has an accurate status and next action.

?  Confirm nothing due tomorrow is incomplete; if it is, escalate tonight — not tomorrow.

?  Save and version all working files; sync SharePoint/OneDrive.

?  Write a two-line end-of-day status for your manager: what advanced, what is blocked.

?  Set tomorrow's top three priorities.



2.4 Weekly Responsibilities



?  Run saved searches across all portals and refresh the pipeline; add new qualified opportunities.

?  Hold a bid-review huddle with estimating: priorities, due dates, resource conflicts.

?  Audit the document library for anything expiring in the next 45 days.

?  Update the KPI dashboard (opportunities reviewed, packages in progress, submissions).

?  Reconcile subcontractor/supplier database additions and note coverage gaps by trade and region.

?  Back up all active bid folders and confirm version control is clean.



2.5 Monthly Responsibilities



?  Full document-library expiration audit (insurance, bonds capacity, registrations, licenses, certifications).

?  Pipeline review with leadership: win rate, hit rate, revenue-weighted pipeline, capacity.

?  Post-bid debrief roll-up: wins, losses, pricing gaps, lessons learned.

?  Verify 
 registration status and renewal timeline; confirm UEI/CAGE active.

?  Refresh saved searches and NAICS coverage; prune dead portals, add new ones.

?  Update templates and this manual with any process improvements approved during the month.



2.6 Quarterly Responsibilities



?  Comprehensive compliance self-audit.

?  Bonding capacity review with the surety/broker; update aggregate and single-job limits.

?  Insurance program review with the broker; confirm limits meet target agencies' requirements.

?  Subcontractor prequalification refresh cycle; re-collect expiring COIs and certifications.

?  KPI trend review and goal reset for the next quarter.

?  Portal registration renewals check (state/county/municipal vendor registrations).



2.7 Annual Responsibilities



?  
 annual renewal (do not let it lapse — an expired registration blocks federal awards).

?  State business registration renewals (NJ, PA, MA) and Public Works Contractor Registration where required.

?  Full document library rebuild/verification and archive of prior-year bids per retention policy.

?  Annual capability statement and past-performance library refresh.

title: Transportation Tracker
description:
AJG Transport is expanding its route operations division and seeking a reliable, detail-oriented professional to help support and streamline our daily transportation duties, with a primary focus on Memphis lanes. Role Overview

As an Transportation Tracker, you will serve as a real time control point within route operations. • Communicate continuously with drivers, brokers, and customers regarding status updates

• Escalate operational risks to leadership when necessary

What Success Looks Like

• Memphis lanes are monitored closely and executed with urgency, accuracy, and consistency

• TMS, Google Sheets, and tracking platforms reflect complete and error-free data at all times

• Scheduled updates are sent on time

• Critical loads are monitored closely and handled with urgency from start to finish

• Communication is clear, concise, and actionable, both in written updates and verbal escalations

• Operational risks and issues are flagged early with solutions, not just problems

• Shift handoffs are smooth, complete, and well documented

• You become someone the team can depend on during high-pressure situations



Who We’re Looking For

• Has experience in logistics, freight brokerage, dispatch, or transportation tracking

• Understanding of fleet coordination, load planning, and HOS awareness

• Familiar with US geography and US logistics trucking operations (a plus)

• Ability to monitor multiple loads and drivers simultaneously

• Minimum 45 WPM typing speed

• Comfortable operating in high volume communication environments

• Follows instructions consistently and values clean execution

• Works well with a team and is open to feedback and coaching. Collaborates without resistance or ego

• Defined KPIs and measurable growth

• Performance recognition and advancement potential

title: L2 Service Engineer
description:
Company: MSP based in CA, USA

Location: Remote

Hours: 8:00 AM – 5:00 PM PST



The Opportunity



We are a growing Managed Service Provider (MSP) based in CA, USA, providing end-to-end IT solutions to our clients. We’re seeking an L2 Service Engineer who will provide advanced technical support for client users and environments, while serving as a key escalation resource for the Help Desk team.



In this role, you will troubleshoot complex technical issues, support service delivery objectives, improve client environments, and contribute to the technical development of less experienced Engineers. You will work closely with clients, Engineers, Service Coordinators, vendors, and leadership to resolve issues efficiently, maintain service quality, and support continuous improvement across the service team.



This role is well suited for someone who is dependable, technically strong, and committed to continuous learning, and who enjoys solving complex problems, taking ownership of challenging issues, mentoring others, and expanding their technical expertise within an MSP environment.





How We Measure Success



-Resolves technical issues efficiently while maintaining high service quality, client satisfaction, and adherence to service standards.



-Serves as a trusted escalation resource through effective troubleshooting, knowledge sharing, and support of less experienced Engineers.



-Demonstrates ongoing technical growth while contributing to continuous improvement, operational efficiency, and alignment with Datastream IT's Core Values.





What You'll Do



Technical Support



-Provide intermediate technical support to client users and environments through phone,
, and remote support tools.



-Troubleshoot, diagnose, and resolve intermediate technical issues involving Microsoft 365, Windows and Mac workstations, Active Directory, Entra ID, Intune, networking, VPNs, servers, virtualization platforms, printers, business applications, and other technologies commonly supported within an MSP environment.



-Take ownership of assigned issues through resolution or proper escalation while maintaining clear communication, documentation, and follow-through.



-Participate in technical projects, maintenance activities, system improvements, and other operational initiatives as assigned.

-Serve as an escalation resource for L1 Service Engineers by providing troubleshooting assistance, knowledge sharing, technical guidance, and issue resolution support.



-Escalate issues appropriately when additional expertise, vendor support, resources, or authorization are required.



Client Service & Documentation



-Maintain professional communication with clients, tea
mbers, vendors, and leadership while managing priorities and client expectations.



-Maintain accurate ticket notes, time entries, status updates, next steps, and technical documentation while following established processes and service standards.



-Support SLA performance by responding to, updating, and progressing assigned tickets in a timely manner.



-Contribute to the development and maintenance of technical documentation, knowledge base resources, and standard operating procedures.



Professional Development



-Demonstrate ongoing technical growth through training, coaching, certifications, and increased responsibilities.



-Provide guidance, knowledge sharing, onboarding support, and technical development assistance to less experienced Engineers when appropriate.



-Maintain reliable attendance, productivity, and adherence to performance expectations.





What We're Looking For



Experience



1. 4+ years of IT support, systems administration, and technical troubleshooting experience; experience within an MSP supporting multiple client environments is preferred.



2. Prior experience handling escalated technical issues and supporting the development of less experienced Engineers is preferred.



Technical Skills



1. Strong troubleshooting and administration skills involving Microsoft 365, Active Directory, Entra ID, Intune, Windows and Mac workstations, networking, firewalls, VPNs, servers, virtualization platforms, printers, business applications, identity management, endpoint management, cybersecurity fundamentals, business continuity, disaster recovery, and other technologies commonly supported within an MSP environment.



2. Ability to troubleshoot and resolve technical issues, identify root causes, develop effective solutions, and appropriately escalate highly complex issues when necessary.



Professional Skills



1. Strong documentation habits, attention to detail, and commitment to maintaining accurate ticket notes, time entries, status updates, and technical documentation.



2. Ability to manage workload effectively, prioritize competing demands, and exercise sound judgment regarding troubleshooting, escalation, client communication, and handling sensitive information.



3. Excellent communication and customer service skills, with the ability to communicate professionally with technical and non-technical users, including end users, managers, business owners, and executive leadership.



4. Ability to work independently while contributing positively to team collaboration, knowledge sharing, and the development of junior tea
mbers.



Tools & Platforms



1. Experience using PSA and ticketing systems such as ConnectWise Manage, HaloPSA, Autotask, or similar platforms.



2. Experience using RMM platforms such as NinjaOne, Datto RMM, ConnectWise Automate, Kaseya, or similar tools.



3. Experience using technical documentation platforms such as IT Glue, Hudu, or similar systems.



4. Experience working with Microsoft 365 administration tools, identity and endpoint management platforms, security tools, backup solutions, and infrastructure management technologies commonly supported within an MSP environment.



Certifications

Microsoft, CompTIA, cybersecurity, cloud, networking, virtualization, or other relevant industry certifications are required.





Work Environment



Requirements include:



-A quiet, professional workspace with reliable high-speed internet, a backup plan for internet or power outages, and an environment suitable for client communication, team collaboration, and video meetings.

-Availability to work during standard business hours (8:00 AM to 5:00 PM PST).

-Flexibility to occasionally work outside normal business hours in response to emergency issues, planned maintenance, client-impacting i
, or operational needs.



How to Apply

2. Your CV / Resume

Applications without a video will be ignored.

“Applicant for an "L2 Service Engineer Position”

title: Print Layout & Artwork Proofing Specialist
description:
If you’re detail-oriented, a fast learner, excellent at following written instructions, and comfortable working with digital artwork and online order systems, you may be exactly who I’m looking for.

Your work will focus on preparing customer artwork for printing, creating accurate layouts, reviewing artwork quality, making improvements where needed, and setting up online orders for final customer approval.

Much of this work will be done using proprietary tools and internal systems, so the most important qualities are strong attention to detail, excellent written English, the ability to learn new tools quickly, and the judgment to know when something needs to be fixed, improved, or clarified before moving forward.

We currently operate a business that requires high-quality print layouts, artwork proofing, and production-ready order preparation. 



Please understand in advance that this application has very specific requirements, resulting in lower competition. Please read it carefully and apply correctly to be considered.



The Job

I’m looking for a full-time Print Layout & Artwork Proofing Specialist who can help prepare online print orders for customer approval and production.

You will be responsible for checking customer artwork, improving files when needed, preparing layouts, and making sure orders are clean, accurate, and ready for the next step.

This is not a heavy illustration or original art role. You do not need to be a professional artist. However, you do need to have a good eye for layout, spacing, image quality, color, alignment, and print-readiness.

The most important aspect of this job is the ability to learn new skills, think critically, follow instructions carefully, and find practical solutions as our tools and processes evolve. If you want to find a place where you can build a career and grow into more responsibility over time, please apply.



Required Skills

Excellent written English is required.

Strong attention to detail is required.

The ability to follow written instructions carefully is required.

A PC or Mac powerful enough to handle browser-based design/proofing tools, image editing tools, online order systems, and communication tools is required.

A fast and stable internet connection is required.

Comfort learning proprietary/internal software tools is required.

Basic familiarity with digital artwork, image quality, file types, print placement, colors, scaling, and layout is strongly preferred.

Experience with Photoshop, Illustrator, is a plus, but not required if you are a fast learner.



You Will Be

Preparing layouts for customer print orders.

Reviewing customer artwork for quality, resolution, color, spacing, sizing, alignment, and print-readiness.

Adjusting and improving customer artwork when needed, including upscaling, cropping, cleaning up, color adjustments, background removal, and other basic improvements.

Using proprietary tools to prepare customer artwork and order proofs.

Setting up online orders for final customer approval.

Writing clear internal notes so the team understands what was changed, what still needs attention, and whether the order is ready.

Identifying artwork problems before they become production problems.

Asking clear written questions when instructions, artwork, or customer requests are unclear.

Following repeatable processes while also using good judgment when something looks wrong.

Helping improve internal systems over time as you learn the role.



Perks

This is intended to be a full-time permanent position.

Vacations are flexible. If you need time off, just let me know in advance. 

You’ll have the opportunity to grow as the business grows. As you become more skilled, reliable, and valuable to the team, there will be opportunities for raises, bonuses, and additional responsibility.

Make sure children look realistic, age-appropriate, natural, and not AI-generated

Keep the product as the main focus of the image

Keep the product accurate and unchanged in the final image

Create product images that look suitable for ecommerce listings

Edit and refine images to fix hands, fingers, lighting, shadows, faces, product placement, scale, and other AI errors

Prepare final images for ecommerce use



Requirements:

Experience creating AI-generated or AI-assisted images featuring children and families

Experience creating ecommerce product images or product lifestyle images

Strong graphic design and photo editing skills

Good understanding of realistic lighting, shadows, hands, faces, and product scale

Ability to follow detailed instructions carefully

Experience with tools such as Photoshop, Canva, Midjourney, ChatGPT image tools, Firefly, Leonardo, or similar AI tools

Good communication and willingness to revise images until they look natural and polished

Experience with Amazon product images is a plus

Experience with kids brands, toy brands, family products, or craft products is a strong plus



Important:

Our customers are sensitive to AI-looking images, especially when children are included. Realism is very important. The final images must look like real lifestyle photography, not fake, distorted, overly polished, or obviously AI-generated.



To apply:

Please send examples of AI lifestyle images you have created that include kids, families, or parents.

Please also send examples of product images or ecommerce lifestyle images you have created.

title: Customer Success Manager (CSM)
description:
Location: Remote (US hours)

About OpenCall 

OpenCall's voice AI handles calls for multi-location medical groups. We're solving a unique challenge: pushing the limits of AI at millisecond performance to have the best human-like customer service experience at enterprise scale. Our AI is faster, cheaper, more powerful, and more reliable than anything else on the market. We let businesses answer the phone and make outbound calls automatically—answering questions, booking appointments, and integrating directly with existing booking software.

We are looking for a Customer Success Manager who can take ownership of our customer relationships and ensure our AI agents are delivering measurable, undeniable value to the medical and dental practices we serve.



About the role 

As a Customer Success Manager at OpenCall, you are the bridge between our multi-location healthcare customers and our engineering/prompt teams. You aren't just doing check-in calls and sending NPS surveys; you are actively managing onboardings, understanding the complexities of medical scheduling, and driving product adoption.

You will own the post-sales lifecycle. When a new clinic comes online, you will guide them through deployment, ensuring their intake forms, scheduling rules, and practice quirks are perfectly translated into our system. You will look for optimization and expansion opportunities, and work directly with our Agent Developers to push automation rates higher and drive up booking numbers.



Responsibilities

- Own the customer lifecycle: Manage the onboarding, adoption, and retention of our medical and dental group partners. You are their primary advocate and point of contact.

- Workflow translation: Work with practice administrators to understand their specific operational rules, edge cases, and EHR/PMS integrations, ensuring our deployment team configures an optimal agent.

- Data-driven optimization: Review real call data and metrics. If a specific objection-handling flow isn't working for a dental clinic in Ohio, you are the one who flags it, measures the drop-off in booking rates, and coordinates the fix.

- Drive retention and expansion: Prove the ROI of OpenCall every single month, enabling the customer to roll out additional locations. You will run monthly and quarterly reviews grounded in hard data: calls handled, hours saved, and appointments booked.

- Feedback loop: Act as the voice of the customer to our product and engineering teams. You will help prioritize feature requests and flag drift or friction in live deployments before the customer even notices.



What we're looking for

- You've managed complex customers and onboardings before. You have 4+ years of experience in Customer Success, Account Management, or Implementation, ideally in SaaS, HealthTech, or a fast-paced startup environment.

- Analytical and empirical. You don't just ask customers how they feel; you look at the dashboard. You are comfortable diving into the data to justify your recommendations.

- Deep empathy mixed with operational rigor. You stay organized when multiple projects are in flight. You understand that in healthcare workflows, a bad deployment costs real money for real practices, and you know how to manage expectations carefully.

- Exceptional communication. You can seamlessly translate highly technical AI concepts to a non-technical front-office manager, and then turn around and translate front-office operational chaos into clear requirements for our engineering team.

- Problem-solving mindset. You are proactive. When a customer is struggling, you don't just log a ticket—you dig in, listen to the failed call recordings, and come to the table with a proposed solution.



Preferred Qualifications

- Prior experience in healthcare operations, SaaS, or contact center technology.

- Familiarity with Hubspot or a similar CRM

- Familiarity with medical/dental scheduling software and workflows, and you've seen how messy a front desk can get.

- Experience working alongside technical teams (engineers, product managers, or AI developers) to iterate on a highly technical product.

title: Billing & Accounts Receivable Specialist
description:
About the role

We are a US-based equipment manufacturer seeking a detail-oriented Billing & Accounts Receivable Specialist to manage the day-to-day accounts receivable and invoicing functions of the company. You will handle customer invoicing, payment application, refunds, and reconciliation between our Fishbowl inventory system and QuickBooks, working closely with our production, sales, and customer service teams as well as directly with customers. You will also lead our weekly open orders meeting and support several ongoing special projects. This is a long-term role for someone who is highly organized, accurate, and a clear communicator.

Key responsibilities

Customer invoicing



Review open tickets and confirm accuracy against purchase orders and company policies

Update customer records in Fishbowl as needed prior to invoicing

Collect prepayments from designated customers before orders are released

Enter invoices into the Fishbowl inventory system

Upload PDF copies of invoices to the associated JIRA ticket and update ticket status to alert the production team



Invoice verification and reconciliation



Confirm the nightly Fishbowl-to-QuickBooks export has run successfully, and request a manual push from technical support when needed

Verify pricing and all invoice details for accuracy

Ensure final invoices are sent to the customer, or notify the appropriate internal recipients if not

Apply prepayments in QuickBooks

Collect remaining payments from prepaid and COD customers, and request payment from customers on net terms

Enter invoices for secondary companies into the appropriate QuickBooks or QuickBooks Online file

Perform currency exchange calculations when required

Correct invoices when errors are identified

Upload PDF copies of equipment invoices to JIRA tickets and update status to "Done" once verified



Accounts receivable



Review daily
s from the accounting team and apply customer payments in QuickBooks using remittance details from wires and correspondence

File customer deposit backup documentation when provided

Contact customers for remittance details when needed

Alert the production team when prepayments on equipment have been received

Monitor unpaid invoices and send payment reminders and statements as appropriate

Notify customers of payment holds and add notes in Fishbowl so new orders are not shipped

Respond to customer inquiries about invoices and payments, including sending copies and revising invoices that contain errors



Refunds processing



Review and download refund submissions from the customer refund portal

Format the refund spreadsheet and remove duplicate submissions, keeping the most accurate information

Communicate with customers when additional information is needed to process a refund

Research and issue refunds through our payment platforms (including Stripe and Nayax)

Create and upload CSV files to issue refund eChecks

Respond to customer refund inquiries by phone and
, and explain the refund process



Weekly open orders meeting



Prepare by reviewing notes and building a spreadsheet of all open orders that have not yet shipped

Track issues as they arise, with notes on actions taken, next steps, and expected resolution dates

Host the virtual meeting, sharing a color-coded, organized spreadsheet and walking the team through each row



Advance exchanges



Confirm exchanged products have been received back at our warehouse or the appropriate vendor

Create credit memos to fully cover in-warranty exchanges, and partial credit memos for out-of-warranty exchanges with the balance collected afterward


 customers to request the return of overdue products



Communication



Review and respond to
, Teams chat, and JIRA-tagged requests from customers and coworkers

Answer the accounting phone line and accept customer payments by phone



Special projects



Maintain a free media tracking spreadsheet for a designated customer, track related payments, communicate with the customer, and create and follow up on JIRA tickets



Must-have qualifications



2 or more years of accounts receivable, invoicing, or general accounting experience

Associate's or Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration, or a related field, or equivalent work experience

Working knowledge of both QuickBooks Desktop and QuickBooks Online (this role uses both)

Strong written and verbal English, since the role includes customer phone contact and hosting a weekly team meeting

Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, including formulas, sorting, filtering, and basic formatting

High accuracy and strong attention to detail when working with financial data

Reliable computer, stable high-speed internet, a headset for calls, and a quiet work environment



Nice to have



Experience with Fishbowl inventory software (strongly preferred; we will train the right person)

Familiarity with JIRA or a similar ticketing system

Experience processing refunds through online payment platforms such as Stripe

Experience with multi-currency invoicing and currency exchange calculations

Experience supporting US-based businesses or B2B customers



Schedule and availability

This is a full-time role, approximately 40 hours per week. We need at least 4 hours of daily overlap with US Eastern Time, so this is an evening or overnight shift in the Philippines. Please only apply if you can reliably commit to these hours.

Confidentiality

This role handles confidential financial and customer information and requires discretion at all times. The successful candidate will sign a non-disclosure agreement, and system access will be limited to what the role requires.

About the role



We are a US-based company seeking a detail-oriented Cash Receipts & Commissions Specialist to own the daily cash receipts function and our location and technician commission process. You will monitor incoming deposits, verify them, and post entries in our accounting software, and you will prepare, verify, and distribute monthly commission reports to our locations as well as process technician commissions. This is a long-term role for someone who is accurate, organized, and comfortable reconciling numbers and communicating with both internal teams and external partners.



Key responsibilities



Cash receipts and deposits





Monitor
 and accounting notifications for incoming cash deposits and customer payments

Verify each deposit for accuracy against expected amounts and supporting documentation

Post deposit and payment entries in the accounting software and apply them to the correct customer, location, or invoice

Capture all receipt types, including cash, ACH and wire remittances, and digital settlement deposits (for example Nayax and Stripe)

Reconcile deposits to the bank feed and clearing accounts so every receipt is matched and nothing is missed or duplicated

Research and resolve deposit discrepancies, short or over amounts, and unidentified receipts, following up with locations or the field team for remittance detail

Maintain the daily deposit log and supporting documentation





Location commissions





Pull each period's revenue data from the reporting system and calculate commissions per each location's contract terms

Verify monthly commission reports for accuracy and send them to the appropriate locations

Maintain the commission rate and terms schedule for each location, including minimum guarantees or true-ups where contracts require them

Reconcile the commission accrual to amounts paid, and respond to location questions or disputes about their statements





Technician commissions





Verify technician commissions against completed service tickets or work orders before posting

Post technician commission entries in the accounting software

Coordinate the payout route (payroll or contractor payment) and track that payments are made

Maintain the technician commission rate rules





Month-end and documentation





Post the related accruals and recurring journal entries

Reconcile the associated balance-sheet accounts, such as undeposited funds and commissions payable

Keep clean, organized backup for every entry and provide documentation for reviews or audits





Communication





Respond to internal and location inquiries by
, chat, and phone

Flag unusual or unresolved items to the finance team promptly





Must-have qualifications





2 or more years of accounts receivable, cash applications, or general accounting experience

Associate's or Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration, or a related field, or equivalent work experience

Working knowledge of QuickBooks (Desktop and/or Online)

Strong written and verbal English, since the role includes phone contact and partner communication

High accuracy and strong attention to detail when working with financial data

Reliable computer, stable high-speed internet, a headset for calls, and a quiet work environment





Nice to have



Experience calculating or administering commissions or revenue-share arrangements

Familiarity with a ticketing system such as JIRA





Schedule and availability

Begin your reply with the word RECONCILE

title: Quality Assurance (QA) Specialist
description:
Location: Remote (Full or partial US hours overlap required)



About OpenCall 



OpenCall's voice AI handles calls for multi-location medical groups. We're solving a unique challenge: pushing the limits of AI at millisecond performance to have the best human-like customer service experience at enterprise scale. Our AI is faster, cheaper, more powerful, and more reliable than anything else on the market. We let businesses answer the phone and make outbound calls automatically—answering questions, booking appointments, and integrating directly with existing booking software.



We are looking for a Quality Assurance Specialist who can rigorously pressure-test our AI agents and ensure they consistently deliver a flawless, human-like conversational experience for the medical and dental practices we serve. 



About the role



As a Quality Assurance Specialist at OpenCall, you are the final line of defense ensuring our AI voice agents sound natural, respond accurately, and navigate complex conversations flawlessly. This is a highly impactful, non-engineering role focused entirely on conversational quality and product reliability.



You will rigorously test both our inbound and outbound phone agents, actively trying to break them by introducing edge cases, unexpected questions, and complex medical scheduling scenarios. You will ensure our AI can handle the unpredictable nature of real human conversations before deployments go live for our medical and dental practices.



Responsibilities



- Conversational Testing: Conduct extensive manual testing of inbound and outbound AI voice agents over the phone, simulating real-world patient interactions, objections, and edge cases.



- Issue Identification & Reporting: Document bugs, prompt failures, unnatural pauses, and conversational dead-ends. You will translate these conversational breakdowns into clear, actionable reports for our engineering and prompt development teams.



- Call Auditing & Grading: Listen to and review call recordings and transcripts from live and test environments to grade AI performance against our strict quality and safety standards.



- Collaborative Iteration: Work closely with Agent Developers and Customer Success Managers to understand customer-specific workflows (like complex dental scheduling rules) and verify that the AI adheres to those precise constraints.



What we're looking for

- Extensive QA or relevant experience: You have 5+ years of experience in quality assurance, conversational design testing, contact center operations, or a highly rigorous analytical role.



- Exceptional English fluency: Because you are evaluating the nuances of spoken English—including tone, register, phrasing, and regional accents—native-level or highly fluent English speaking and listening skills are an absolute requirement.



- Meticulous attention to detail: You notice the subtle difference between an AI sounding "helpful" versus "robotic," and you possess the focus required to run through dozens of conversational flows without letting small errors slip through the cracks.



- Tech-savvy problem solver: You do not need to be an engineer or write code, but you must be highly comfortable working alongside technical teams, navigating internal dashboards, and utilizing modern software tools to log your findings.



Preferred Qualifications

- Full overlap with US business hours (partial overlap is acceptable for the ideal candidate).

- Prior experience testing voice AI, chatbots, LLMs, or working in conversational AI.

- Familiarity with healthcare operations, medical/dental scheduling workflows, or terminology.

title: Flooring Estimator
description:
About United Floor Coatings



United Floor Coatings is a U.S.-based concrete flooring contractor specializing in commercial, industrial, and residential flooring systems. Our services include epoxy flooring, decorative flake and quartz systems, urethane cement, polished concrete, sealed concrete, concrete repair, and specialty resinous flooring.



We are looking for a reliable and detail-oriented remote estimator to review project documents, complete flooring takeoffs, prepare estimates, and assist our sales team with commercial and industrial opportunities.



Position Overview



The estimator will be responsible for reviewing construction plans, specifications, photographs, customer information, and project requirements to determine the labor, materials, equipment, and other costs required to complete each project.



This position requires strong attention to detail, good mathematical skills, construction knowledge, and the ability to identify flooring requirements within architectural plans and project specifications.



The ideal candidate has experience estimating commercial flooring, epoxy flooring, concrete polishing, painting, concrete work, or another construction trade. Training on our specific systems and estimating process will be provided to a candidate with strong general estimating experience.



Primary Responsibilities

Review architectural drawings, specifications, finish schedules, addenda, and other project documents.

Complete accurate square-foot and linear-foot takeoffs.

Identify epoxy flooring, resinous flooring, polished concrete, sealed concrete, concrete repair, cove base, floor preparation, and related scope items.

Review room finish schedules and flooring plans to determine which systems apply to each area.

Identify project alternates, exclusions, special requirements, and potential scope conflicts.

Determine appropriate surface-preparation methods, including grinding, shot blasting, coating removal, tile removal, and concrete repair.

Calculate estimated quantities for primers, epoxy basecoats, quartz, decorative flake, urethane cement, polyaspartic topcoats, densifiers, guards, joint fillers, and other materials.

Estimate labor requirements, equipment needs, mobilization, lodging, disposal, and other project expenses.

Prepare organized and professional estimates for review by management.

Request pricing from suppliers and subcontractors when necessary.

Review bid invitations and determine whether projects are a good fit for the company.

Submit proposals and required bid documents before established deadlines.

Track estimates, follow-up dates, bid results, and awarded projects.

Assist the sales team with proposal revisions, value-engineering options, and customer questions.

Maintain accurate estimating records, pricing information, and project files.

Communicate promptly with management when plans are incomplete or project requirements are unclear.

Types of Projects You May Estimate

Manufacturing and industrial facilities

Warehouses and distribution centers

Commercial kitchens and food-processing facilities

Automotive service facilities

Aircraft hangars

Schools and universities

Healthcare facilities

Offices and retail spaces

Parking decks and mechanical rooms

Residential garages and workshops

Flooring Systems You May Estimate

Decorative epoxy flake flooring

Single- and double-broadcast quartz flooring

Solid-color epoxy systems

Polyaspartic and polyurea coatings

Urethane cement flooring

Chemical-resistant epoxy and novolac systems

Polished concrete

Grind-and-seal concrete

Concrete densifiers and guards

Concrete coating removal

Joint filling and concrete repair

Integral cove base

Safety striping and facility markings

Required Qualifications

Previous experience in construction estimating, quantity takeoffs, commercial flooring, concrete, painting, or a related trade.

Ability to read and understand architectural drawings, specifications, finish schedules, and construction documents.

Strong mathematical and measurement skills.

Excellent attention to detail.

Strong written and spoken English.

Ability to communicate clearly through
, chat, and video meetings.

Good organizational and time-management skills.

Ability to manage multiple estimates and deadlines simultaneously.

Reliable computer, high-speed internet connection, and a professional remote workspace.

Proficiency with Microsoft Excel or Google Sheets.

Willingness to learn epoxy flooring and concrete-polishing systems.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience estimating epoxy, resinous flooring, polished concrete, commercial flooring, painting, or concrete work.

Experience using Bluebeam Revu, PlanSwift, STACK, MeasureSquare, or similar takeoff software.

Familiarity with construction bidding platforms such as BuildingConnected, ConstructConnect, PlanHub, or Dodge.

Knowledge of surface preparation, concrete moisture issues, coating removal, and concrete repair.

Experience working remotely with a U.S.-based construction company.

Experience preparing proposals, managing bid calendars, or assisting a construction sales team.

Performance Expectations



Success in this position will be measured by:



Accuracy and completeness of takeoffs

Timely completion of estimates

Ability to identify missing or conflicting project information

Organization and quality of project records

Number and value of qualified estimates completed

Projects awarded and revenue generated from completed estimates

Effective communication with management and the sales team

Compensation



This position includes:



Competitive fixed salary

Commission eligibility based on awarded projects and company performance

Opportunities for increased responsibility and compensation

Training in specialized commercial and industrial flooring systems

Long-term growth opportunities with an established U.S. contractor



Exact salary and commission details will be discussed based on experience and qualifications.



Work Schedule



The selected candidate must be able to maintain a consistent full-time schedule and provide sufficient overlap with U.S. Eastern Time business hours. Some flexibility may be available once training is completed and performance expectations are consistently met.

As assigned, including data collection, referral coordination support, and assisting with patient consent processes.

Education & Licensure

Skills

Strong organizational and time-management skills.

Proficiency with computers, EMR/EHR systems, and telehealth tools.

Ability to work independently in a remote setting while collaborating across time zones.

Availability

Other



Willingness to complete company-specific training on US Medicare CCM/RPM guidelines, EMR systems (e.g., WellSky), and protocols.

What We Offer



Competitive compensation, commensurate with experience.

Opportunities for professional development and potential pathways to additional US credentials.

Supportive, mission-driven team environment.

Equipment/setup assistance as needed.

Performance-based incentives and growth opportunities within our expanding organization.

title: Patient Intake & Scheduling Coordinator
description:
This role owns everything that happens from the 
nt a patient is referred to Previvor Edge up to the 
nt they have a scheduled appointment. You will monitor incoming referrals, build out each patient's record, reach out across text and phone, and drive them to book their first visit. This is a high-volume, high-touch role that directly determines how many referred patients actually become seen patients.



Core Responsibilities



New Patient Intake

• Monitor WhatsApp throughout the day for newly referred patients

• Follow up in WhatsApp with the referring source when required information is missing (e.g. referring provider info, genetic testing info)

• Transcribe patient demographics from WhatsApp into the Daily Ops File, column by column

• Create a patient profile (PPP) for each newly referred patient

Outreach & Scheduling

• Send the initial patient invite via the Baker Health app or manual SMS

• Call each patient to offer and complete appointment scheduling (future phase)

• Call ‘stale’ patients — referred but not yet scheduled — on a recurring cadence (future phase)

• Escalate any patient who is unreachable after the standard outreach sequence, or who raises a clinical question you're not positioned to answer



Tools You'll Use

• WhatsApp (referral intake)

• athenaOne / Baker Health Athena (patient records)

• Daily Ops File (Google Sheets / Excel)

• Backstage (scheduling, magic links)

• SMS (Twilio) and the Baker Health in-app messaging channel



What We're Looking For

• 5+ years in a patient-facing, customer support, or BPO healthcare/insurance role, ideally supporting US patients or customers

• Excellent written and spoken English; comfortable on the phone with US patients discussing sensitive health topics

• High attention to detail — this role touches PHI and billing-relevant data daily; errors here cause downstream claims and care problems
